planned_by: Critic live check of T15 (production defect)
goal:
PRODUCTION DEFECT in your T15 services/api/evoforge/repo_source.py: _run_git sends `-c http.extraHeader=Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A live fetch of the real private repo failed ('GitHub fetch failed'); `git ls-remote` with the Bearer header fails ('could not read Username'), while `Authorization: Basic base64("x-access-token:<token>")` succeeds. Second issue: passing the header with -c puts the token in the process argv (visible to anything that can list processes).
SPEC: (1) git authentication header = 'Authorization: Basic ' + base64('x-access-token:' + GITHUB_TOKEN). (2) Pass it ONLY through the subprocess environment using git's GIT_CONFIG_COUNT / GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n> / GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n> mechanism (key http.extraheader), never in argv; also keep GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and disable credential helpers. No token -> no header. (3) redact() must also strip the base64 Basic form. (4) The GitHub REST call in resolve_ref_to_sha keeps 'Authorization: Bearer' (REST accepts it). Nothing else changes.
